steps.say: Angstrom Signals has two price charts. | The fast chart, built for trading, and the classic chart, the original. | Both use the same readings and indicators.
Pick one in Settings, under Price chart. | TradingView is the fast chart, and it's the one we'll use in this series.
Click any asset in the signal tables, and it opens in the Interactive Chart.
Choose the candle size, from five minutes to monthly, and how much history the chart opens on. | A crossed-out range doesn't work with that candle size.
Scroll to zoom in and out, and drag to move back in time. | The two buttons at the top right go back to your range, or jump to the newest candle.
Point at any candle. | The legend at the top shows its open, high, low and close, and the value of every line on the chart.
Turn indicators on and off with these pills. | Panels such as Stoch RSI open underneath the price. | All and Clear, at the end of the row, switch them all at once.
Drag the bar under the chart to make it taller or shorter. | Your choices are saved to your account.
That's the basics. | Next: the drawing tools, the price levels traders watch, the signals drawn on the chart, and planning an entry.
